name: seqsalvage
description: Import 'Sequencher' Sanger Sequencing Projects into R

paragraphs: seqsalvage reads data from proprietary molecular biology software into R. It currently supports Sequencher project files (.SPF). It can extract the chromatograms, base calls, quality scores and peak positions stored in a project, and write them back out as .ab1 trace files.

We aim to support open science and reproducible research by reducing dependence on proprietary software, which can lock a lab out of its own data once the software stops running. Sequencher 5.4 for Mac, for example, is a 32-bit application and no longer opens on current macOS. Since these file formats are not publicly documented, the parsers are developed through reverse engineering and implemented directly in base R. If you run into a file that doesn't parse correctly (or at all), please open an issue.
